name: Franklin Barbecue Sauce
about: A bottled sauce from Franklin Barbecue, one of Austin's best-known barbecue restaurants. It captures the city's smoked-meat food culture.
tip: Pack the bottle in checked luggage, since liquids are not allowed in carry-on bags.

name: Texas Cowboy Boots
about: Handmade-style leather boots tied to Texas's Western heritage. They are a classic piece of local style.
tip: Check the leather quality and the fit before you buy, especially the width around the toes.
